warehouse.title: How Long Does Kakobuy Store Items? Storage & Status Guide
warehouse.description: Check the 100-day normal storage rule, what storing and to be stored mean, and when to contact support before a deadline.
steps: How long does Kakobuy hold items in the warehouse?

The official storage help describes 100 days for normal purchasing and forwarding packages, counted from the in storage status. Check each item’s date in your account. The same help gives a separate 60-day rule for abnormal, unmatched packages starting from signed for; do not apply the normal period to every delivered parcel.
What do storing and to be stored mean?

These labels concern warehouse processing, not international transit. Check the item record for intake, inspection and storage confirmation. A seller’s delivered scan is not the same as a stored item, and wording can vary by interface. If the status is unclear, ask which physical step is complete rather than guessing a departure date.
Delivered but the item is not visible

Match the seller’s domestic tracking number to the order and confirm whether the seller used several parcels. Send support the order reference, delivery event, contents and date. Ask for intake and account matching to be checked. Do not place a duplicate order solely because the warehouse record has not appeared.
Check QC before waiting for more items

Review the ordered size, colour, quantity and available photos promptly. Storage time and seller return eligibility are separate. Request a missing measurement or open a return question while the relevant process is available; waiting to consolidate does not extend a seller’s deadline.
Do not rely on a reminder at the last moment

The official page describes a reminder after 90 days for normal packages and disposal of overdue goods under its stated conditions. Unmatched packages may not receive reminders. Set an earlier personal deadline and contact support before expiry if anything is unresolved. Do not assume storage can be extended.
Before releasing the parcel

Resolve open QC or return questions, check contents and address, then compare packed weight, dimensions and eligible routes. Keep the oldest item’s date visible when waiting for another seller. Use the calculator for a weight scenario and the current official estimator for the available shipping quote.

returns.title: How to Return Kakobuy Items: Steps, Fees & Refunds
returns.description: Check seller eligibility, gather QC evidence and confirm return costs before warehouse dispatch. Keep storage and return deadlines separate.
steps: Check the order stage and eligibility first

Open the exact order and read its current after-sales options. A request before seller dispatch differs from a warehouse return, and an international parcel claim is another process. Ask whether the item and seller support your requested remedy and what deadline applies; do not treat a general service label as universal coverage.
Send a specific return request

Include the order number, selected size or colour, observed mismatch and relevant QC view. State whether you want a return or exchange. If a photograph is missing, request that evidence first rather than claiming the item is defective. Keep confirmation of the request and the response privately.
Confirm costs before accepting the remedy

Ask for return domestic postage, any handling charge, replacement delivery and the expected refund amount. A product price is not automatically the amount returned. For an exchange, confirm availability and the additional journey before deciding whether other ready items should wait.
Keep packaging and pause parcel release

Retain tags and necessary packaging while eligibility is being checked. Avoid irreversible value-added work or international submission for an item under dispute. Shipping it abroad can change which remedies are practical. Release unaffected items separately only after comparing the complete shipping cost.
Follow the refund to its actual destination

Record approval, seller receipt and the final credit separately. A platform-balance refund is different from a withdrawal to your original payment method. Check the actual amount and any deductions in the account. Do not count a pending refund as available money or subtract the same credit twice.
If the parcel has already arrived abroad

Use the official after-sales or carrier claim process appropriate to the issue. Keep packaging, item photos and delivery evidence. Ask promptly for the applicable reporting deadline. A warehouse return guide cannot guarantee a seller remedy after international delivery.

qcTroubleshooting.title: Kakobuy QC Photos Not Loading? Checks & Next Steps
qcTroubleshooting.description: Find the correct order, separate missing images from product defects, and request the photo or measurement needed before shipping.
steps: Confirm that you are viewing the right item

Match order number, variant and warehouse status. A seller’s listing photo is not a warehouse QC photograph. If the item is still awaiting intake, ask whether inspection and photography have happened rather than assuming an upload failure.
Separate an image display problem from missing evidence

Refresh the item page, reopen the official account and check whether other photographs load. A second browser or device can help distinguish a local display issue. Do not submit a parcel simply to test the interface. If the image is absent everywhere, ask support whether it exists and request access to the relevant view.
Request one useful photo or measurement

Specify what would change your decision: the size label, both shoes together, a damaged corner or a laid-flat measurement with visible endpoints. Explain the ordered option and the question. Check any displayed extra-photo fee before ordering a service; requesting every possible angle is not always necessary.
Compare visible facts before accepting

Check quantity, colour, labels, size and obvious damage against the order. Photos do not establish authenticity, electrical function, comfort or long-term durability. Official inspection guidance describes limits. An unclear view should remain an open question rather than becoming an invented pass or failure.
Report a mismatch while the remedy is available

Save the relevant image and describe the difference precisely. Ask whether a return or exchange is available for that seller and item. Keep tags and packaging intact and avoid international submission until the question is resolved. A long storage allowance does not extend a seller’s return period.
When to contact support

Provide order reference, current status, the missing image or visible issue, and the checks already attempted. Keep personal labels and account screenshots private. Ask for the next action and applicable deadline, then record the response so the same issue does not get lost among other warehouse items.
